home.intro_body1: Sons of Damascene ni ateliye yo mu muryango i Kigali, u Rwanda. Dutekereza kandi twubaka ibitanda, ameza, intebe, ibibyoroshye n'ibintu byihariye—buri kimwe kikorwa n'inzuzu zivuye mu Rwanda kandi zikarangiwa n'intoki.
home.intro_body2: Buri kintu gitangira n'ikiganiro. Tubwire ivyo ushaka, kandi tuzakigerageza.
home.collage_materials_body: Dukora n'inzuzu zivuye mu mashyamba y'u Rwanda—mahogany, eucalyptus, pine na rosewood—zahiswe kubera imigozi, ukuramara n'ubushyuhe.
home.collage_cta_body: Reba urutonde rwacu kugira ngo ubone ibyiyumvo, hanyuma utugemurire kuri WhatsApp kugira ngo utangire igiporisi cyawe.
home.collage_process_body: Tekereza. Kora. Rangira. Tanga. Intambwe zose zikorwa mu workshop yacu i Kigali n'uko ni n'intoki zifashe inzuzu. Tuguha amakuru kuva ku gishushanyo cya mbere kugeza ku gutangaza.

about.title: Ibyerekeye Sons of Damascene
about.heading: Workshop Yubatswe ku Gukora Buhoro Buhoro
about.body1: Sons of Damascene yashinzwe i Kigali bufite intego imwe gusa: gukora fenituri izaramara ubuzimu. Abakora bacu bize uburambe bwabo binyuze mu myaka yo gukorana, basuzuma imigozi n'amashimo no gukora kugeza batangira gukora akazi kazunguruka inkuru.
about.body2: Twizera ko fenituri nziza ireba ntirangurura. Icara mu cyumba bituje kandi nziza ikazidi gusimba imyaka.
about.value_craft_body: Buri mashimo akorwa n'intoki. Buri mbere ikarangiwa n'intoki. Ntidutinda.
about.value_durability_body: Dukoresha inzuzu zizaramara imyaka n'imishyikirano. Fenituri yacu ikozwe kugira ngo ihabwe abazasubiraho.
about.value_local_body: Tuha agaciro mashyamba y'u Rwanda na ba muterankunga bemerewe, tugira uruhare mu buzima bw'ibidukikije.

craftsman.title: Umuhanga Wacu
craftsman.heading: Sobanukirwa Umukora
craftsman.intro: Intoki inyuma ya Sons of Damascene zafashe inzuzu imyaka irenze cumi n'itanu. Avutse i Kigali, yize binyuze mu gukorana n'inyangamugayo, umukora wacu w'ingenzi azanye uburambe bw'amaguru kuri buri kintu kituye akazi.
craftsman.approach_heading: Uburyo Bushingiye ku Gukora Buhoro Buhoro
craftsman.approach_body: Fenituri nziza ntishobora gukorwa vuba. Umukora wacu ahitamo ishati buri kimwe ku buryo bwawe, asuzuma imigozi n'ubukomere mbere y'uko akorwa. Inzego ni akazi kazaboneka neza imyaka myinshi.
craftsman.tools_body: Imbago, inzato, indashyikirwa na chisel bikorana n'ibikoresho by'ibikorwa by'ubu. Ihuriro ritanga kurangwa no gufatirwa. Turangira amavuta n'inzuki z'umwaka—nta plastike, nta isinthetic.
